background.name: Fey-Touched

_.special: One token (your choice) representing your relation to the fey

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: You can speak, read, and write {@language Sylvan}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: One token (your choice) representing your relation to the fey, {@item fine clothes|PHB|fine clothing}, and 10gp.

entries: You have, in one way or another, been touched by the fey. You might have a friendly relationship with them, and they treat your words as higher than those of other mortals, or you may have accidentally given your name to one of them in your youth, or you may a spark of their magic from far back in your bloodline. Those who find their paths speckled with fey magic tend to be specially in tune with the nature around them, and have a natural talent towards convincing others to see their point of view.

background.name: Spirit of the Wild

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: You can speak, read, and write one language of your choosing.

entries: You have been touched by wild magic, the force of chaos that underlies creation. In one way or another, this has followed you throughout your life, whether that be granting you a special affinity towards magic, or causing horrible things to follow in your wake. This has led you to wander from place to place, with no permanent residence to call home. Through this, your body and mind have gained an ability to weather the elements, as well as survive them, and you have picked up knowledge of other cultures from your travels.

race.name: Fey-Touched Tiefling
entries: As a Fey-Touched Tiefling, you gain the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Fey-Touched tieflings tend to live longer than other variants of tiefling, likely due to the magic they carry. On average, they live to around 150 years.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common} and {@language Sylvan}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Thanks to your fey heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||darkness} as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern colors in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Legacy of the Fey
entries: Your fey ancestry has granted you magical abilities. You know the {@spell Dancing Lights} and {@spell Prestidigitation} cantrips. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell Disguise Self} spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the {@spell Crown of Madness} spell once with this trait. Once you cast {@spell Disguise Self} or {@spell Crown of Madness} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this species).

race.name: Wild Magic Tiefling
entries: As a Wild Magic Tiefling, you gain the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Wild magic tieflings mature at the same rate as {@race human||humans}, but live a bit longer.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common} and {@language Primordial}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Thanks to your magical heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||darkness} as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern colors in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The pure chaos that spawned you has granted you an ever-shifting defense against elemental magic. After each long rest, roll a d6 on the Chaotic Resilience Table. Depending on the result, you have resistance to one of six damage types:

entries.caption: Chaotic Resilience
rows: Acid
Cold
Fire
Lightning
Poison
Thunder

entries.name: Legacy of Chaos
entries: The chaos you emerged from has granted you abilities specific to your kind. You know the {@spell Elementalism|XPHB} and {@spell Thaumaturgy} cantrips. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell Chromatic Orb} spell at 2nd level with this trait, without requiring a material component. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell Shatter} spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast {@spell Chromatic Orb} or {@spell Shatter} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this species).
{@spell Elementalism|XPHB} is a 5.5e spell. If you don't want to use any 5.5e content, you can replace it with the {@spell Druidcraft} cantrip.

raceFluff.name: Fey-Touched Tiefling
entries: Rather than being born of the demonic, tieflings of this variant have had their bloodline touched by the magic of the Feywild. Their bodies have been altered by this magic from a normal human's appearance. They might have cloven feet, wings that cannot lift their body weight, or have brightly colored skin.

raceFluff.name: Wild Magic Tiefling
entries: Instead of being born of the demonic, these tieflings were touched by or spawned into being by wild magic itself. Consequently, their form is wild magic's best attempt at creating a mortal; their body isn't quite what it should be. They might be missing a limb, have one leg shorter than the other, or not have eyes.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Carrion

entries: Decay exists as an extant form of life.

Like all druids, you are deeply in tune with nature and its workings. However, you understand that in order for life to flourish, some of those belonging to it must rot. You have dedicated yourself to ensuring that this part of the cycle of life is fulfilled sufficiently to maintain balance.
Those who dedicate themselves to the Circle of Carrion wield powerful necrotic spells, and bond themselves to other creatures in the ecosystem who fulfill the same purpose.

subclassFeature.name: Circle Spells
entries: {@i 2nd-level Circle of Carrion feature}
Your magic grants you an innate knowledge of life and death, granting you access to additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Circle of Carrion Spells table.

Once you gain access to one of these spells, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

subclassFeature.name: Friend of the Scavengers
entries: {@i 2nd-level Circle of Carrion feature}

Your magical specialties have led you to befriend the scavengers and carrion eaters in the ecosystem. Beginning at 2nd level, you can summon beast-type creatures who share your goal of continuing the cycle of life. These must be singular creatures, not swarms, and approved by your GM. These creatures act independently of you, but always obey your commands. You can do this twice per long rest, with scavengers and carrion eaters of up to CR 1.

While they are summoned, you and the creature can understand each other's speech. Additionally, you can take an action to see through its eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses that the creature has. During this time, you are {@condition deafened||deaf} and {@condition blinded||blind} with regard to your own senses.

During combat, your summoned creature rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn. If they have an action on their stat block that allows them to attack, they can attack hostile creatures. If the animal drops to 0 hit points during combat, you can use your action to magically restore the creature by sacrificing an amount of HP equal to at least half its max HP, with the creature being revived with the amount of hit points you sacrificed, or to magically sap the remaining life energy from its body, returning its carcass to the earth and regaining an amount of HP equal to half the creature's max HP. These creatures can benefit from healing spells such as {@spell Cure Wounds}.
The summoning of this creature lasts for a number of hours equal to half your druid level.
This ability scales as you level up. Please refer to the Friend of the Scavengers Table for more information.

entries: Examples of such creatures you could summon are ravens, vultures, polar bears, sharks, lions, and coyotes.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Decay
entries: {@i 6th-level Circle of Carrion feature}

The energy of death and rot follows you. Plant life around you slowly withers and dies, and when you will it, it can grow powerful enough to affect larger creatures. You gain resistance to necrotic and poison damage. Additionally, as an action, you can summon the rot you radiate onto hostile creatures within 15 feet of you, decreasing their AC by 2. A creature can only be affected by this once per combat. The penalty to AC increases to 3 at 10th level, 4 at 14th level, and 5 at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Lord of the Carrion Eaters
entries: {@i 10th-level Circle of Carrion feature}

The scavengers grow fonder of you. Beginning at 10th level, you can summon multiple creatures using your {@subclassFeature Friend of the Scavengers|Druid|PHB|Carrion|GlensGrimoireOfMayhem|2} ability. Their CR must add up to the maximum CR you are able to summon, and you can summon a number of creatures up to twice the maximum CR you are able to summon.

subclassFeature.name: Purveyor of Rot
entries: {@i 14th-level Circle of Carrion feature}

The decay that follows you has grown stronger. You gain immunity to necrotic and poison damage. Additionally, your Aura of Decay action increases to a radius of 30 feet and you use its action, and in addition to the AC penalty, the creatures targeted also make a Constitution saving throw. If they fail the saving throw, they take {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage, and take it again at the beginning of each of their turns. At the end of the creature's turn, they can remake the Constitution saving throw. On a success, the effect ends.
At 18th level, the necrotic damage increases to {@damage 3d8}.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of Focus

entries: Patience yields focus.

The Oath of Focus is for those who have dedicated their lives to mastering a facet of the art of combat, and using that knowledge to protect others. This may be a certain weapon, or a certain style of fighting, or even a specific moral code. No matter how you swing it, these people are some of the most skilled warriors you can come across.

subclassFeature.name: Tenets of Focus
entries: While the exact wording varies from person to person, these are the tenets that these paladins live by:

entries.name: Dedication
entries: Devote your time to your craft, and aim to master its ways.

entries.name: Determination
entries: Stick to your morals, and let none cause you to stray from your path.

entries.name: Deference
entries: Respect others and their expertise, and learn from them whenever you can.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: {@i 3rd-level Oath of Focus feature}
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the Oath of Focus Spells table. See the Sacred Oath class feature for how oath spells work.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity
entries: {@i 3rd-level Oath of Focus feature}
When you take this oath at 3rd level, you gain the following two {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|PHB|3} options:

subclassFeature.name: Focused Blade
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action during combat, you can use your {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|PHB|3} to make two weapon attacks. This scales to 3 at 5th level, 4 at 9th level, 5 at 13th level, and 6 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Peerless Skill
entries: As a free action, you can use your {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|PHB|3} to gain Expertise in one skill or tool for 8 hours.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Determination
entries: {@i 7th-level Oath of Focus feature}

Your aura of sheer competence passes on your expertise to others close to you. Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 5 feet of you score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 10 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Craft Mastery
entries: {@i 15th-level Oath of Focus feature}

You have trained at such length that you have gained special expertise in your ability to wield weapons. At 15th level, you can double the damage dice for one weapon attack that does bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage once per turn. If this attack's damage type is altered by a spell, item, or ability, such as the author's own {@spell Robin's Elemental Versatility|GlensGrimoireOfMayhem}, you may choose whether the extra damage is the new damage type, or the original damage type done by your weapon.

subclassFeature.name: Time to Lock In
entries: {@i 20th-level Oath of Focus feature}
Your focus has grown so strong that it augments your power. At 20th level, you can use your bonus action to trigger a state where your sheer willpower increases your abilities:

items: You have advantage on one weapon attack per turn.
You score a critical hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.
You can use your bonus action to give an ally within 10 feet of you advantage on their next attack.

entries: This state lasts for one minute, and can only be activated twice per long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of Service

entries: Remember, you do it for him
And you would do it again
You do it for her
That is to say,
You'll do it for him.

The Oath of Service is not an common path, due to the risks that accompany it. It is made to a single person, or a select group of people, and requires the swearer to protect these people until death comes for either one. This oath is often sworn to friends, family, a partner or spouse, or even as large a group as a city or nation.
A partnership made through the Oath of Service that lasts through years of dangers and trials is held in very high esteem, as such a bond is rare and valuable.

Paladins who choose this oath and lose those they swear it to will often seek out others who have experienced the same thing, and spend weeks, months, years, or even the rest of their lives with their fellows who have also lost their loved ones.

subclassFeature.name: Tenets of Service
entries: While the exact wording varies from person to person, these are the tenets that these paladins live by:

entries.name: Devotion to Others
entries: Defend those who you choose to love with your life and everything you have at your disposal.

entries.name: Devotion to Self
entries: To truly love others, one must first be able to love one's self. Care for your physical and mental well-being, and walk the path of self-acceptance.

entries.name: Devotion to Balance
entries: To make the world a safer place for those you love, maintain the balance of good and evil in every place you go.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: {@i 3rd-level Oath of Service feature}
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the Oath of Service Spells table. See the Sacred Oath class feature for how oath spells work.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity
entries: {@i 3rd-level Oath of Service feature}
When you take this oath at 3rd level, you gain the following two {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|PHB|3} options:

subclassFeature.name: Strike of the Protector
entries: As a reaction to an ally being attacked by a hostile creature within 10 ft. of you, you make an {@action opportunity attack} against the hostile creature using your {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|PHB|3}. When this attack is made, you can use 1st level {@classFeature Divine Smite|Paladin|PHB|2} without consuming a spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: Watchful Eye
entries: As a free action, you can use your {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|PHB|3} to touch a willing creature, and for the next 24 hours, you can tell the general direction of that creature in relation to you.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of the Defender
entries: {@i 7th-level Oath of Service feature}

Beginning at 7th level, your devotion to your loved ones is so strong that has a worldly manifestation. At the beginning of combat, you and friendly creatures who start their turn within 10 ft. of you roll two of their hit dice. They then gain the result of that plus your Charisma modifier in {@quickref temporary hit points||3}. This does not expend any of the creature's hit dice. A creature can only gain this bonus once per combat.
When you reach 18th level in this class, the range of the aura increases to 20 ft.

subclassFeature.name: Magical Awareness
entries: {@i 15th-level Oath of Service feature}

Starting at 15th level, you can cast {@spell Detect Magic} at will. Once per short rest, you can modify the spell to extend its range by 30 feet, and double its effectiveness at penetrating barriers. This version of the spell is blocked by 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of common metal, a sheet of lead 3 millimeters thick, or 6 feet of wood or dirt.

subclassFeature.name: Blessing of Love
entries: {@i 20th-level Oath of Service feature}
At level 20, you can gift some of the power you possess to others. As a bonus action, you can choose one creature within 30 feet of you, and for 10 minutes, they gain these benefits:

items: They can spend their bonus action to gain advantage on an attack roll, or give a target of a spell disadvantage on a saving throw.
They have resistance to radiant damage, as well as non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
They regain a number of hit points equal to your Charisma modifier at the start of each of their turns.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Arctic Drifter

entries: Some say the world will end in fire, some say in ice.
You were drawn to the frigidity of winter, and eventually became one with it. The time you have spent in the cold has granted you the ability to cast magic harnessing it.

Rangers of this conclave usually reside in the iciest parts of the world, befriending the creatures who live alongside them and surviving off the land. They will sometimes serve as guides to those who end up lost in the wastelands that they make their home.

subclassFeature.name: Arctic Drifter Magic
entries: {@i 3rd-level Arctic Drifter feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Arctic Drifter Spells table. Each spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Frigid Strikes
entries: {@i 3rd-level Arctic Drifter feature}

Your weapons are infused with the power of the freezing cold. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} cold damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn.
The extra damage increases to {@damage 2d6} when you reach 11th level in this class.

subclassFeature.name: Subzero Survivalist
entries: {@i 3rd-level Arctic Drifter feature}

Your time living in the cold has taught you things about the wilderness. You gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival} skill if you don't already have it, and you gain a bonus to {@skill Survival} checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1). Additionally, when walking on ice or snow, your movement speed is doubled.

subclassFeature.name: Glacial Guardian
entries: {@i 7th-level Arctic Drifter feature}

Your body has grown used to freezing temperatures. You gain resistance to cold damage. Additionally, as a reaction to being targeted by a weapon attack or spell, you can summon a shield of ice 10 feet high and 15 feet wide that grants you and any other creatures behind it a +3 bonus to their AC. The shield remains in place for 1 minute, and then melts back into water. You can use this ability twice per short rest. This scales to 3 uses at 11th level, 4 uses at 15th level, and 5 uses at 19th level.

subclassFeature.name: Icy Assailant
entries: {@i 11th-level Arctic Drifter feature}

You have honed your control over the cold to the point where it burns through even the toughest of exteriors. Cold damage you deal now ignores cold resistance. When you reach 15th level in this class, cold damage you deal treats immunity to cold damage as resistance.

subclassFeature.name: Polar Monarch
entries: {@i 15th-level Arctic Drifter feature}
You have made yourself at home in freezing temperatures. You gain immunity to cold damage.

Additionally, your icy magic has grown more potent. When casting a spell that deals cold damage, you can cast it as if you had expended a spell slot one level higher than the one you expended. For example, if you cast the {@spell Frost Fingers|IDRotF} spell using a spell slot of 2nd level, you can instead cast it as if you had cast it using a spell slot of 3rd level. You can use this feature twice, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. When you reach 18th level in this class, you can use it three times between long rests.

subclassFeature.name: Storm Chaser

entries: You are lightning made flesh. Colder than falling snow. Unstoppable as the desert sands riding the wind.

Unlike most of those with common sense, you are so fascinated by storms that you choose to seek them out, memorizing weather patterns and honing your sense of direction to become closer to the sky. In doing so, you have learned magic to harness their powers.

subclassFeature.name: Storm Chaser Magic
entries: {@i 3rd-level Storm Chaser feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Storm Chaser Spells table. Each spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Tempestuous Strikes
entries: {@i 3rd-level Storm Chaser feature}

Your weapons are infused with the power of the storms that you follow. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} lightning or thunder damage (you choose) to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn.
The extra damage increases to {@damage 2d6} when you reach 11th level in this class.

subclassFeature.name: Weathervane Sense
entries: {@i 3rd-level Storm Chaser feature}

Your connection to the weather grants you the ability to sense the patterns of the winds. You gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature} skill if you don't already have it, and you gain a bonus to {@skill Nature} checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1). Additionally, you always know which way the wind is blowing, and can always tell which direction is north.

subclassFeature.name: Lightning Rod
entries: {@i 7th-level Storm Chaser feature}
Your link to the storms has grown stronger. You gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage.
Additionally, when an ally you can see would take lightning or thunder damage, you can take a reaction to take that damage instead.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Squalls
entries: {@i 11th-level Storm Chaser feature}

You have learned the ways of summoning storms. You learn the {@spell Call Lightning} spell. It doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.
Additionally, you can now ride the storm winds. You gain a magical flying speed of 20 feet, and when you are outside while it is storming, it doubles to 40 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Lightning Keeper
entries: {@i 15th-level Storm Chaser feature}

You have fully attuned with the storm. As an action while you are airborne, you can slam yourself to the ground, dealing {@damage 6d8} lightning or thunder damage (your choice) to any creature within 30 feet of you. You can use this action once per long rest, or expend a 4th level or higher spell slot to do it again. This scales to {@damage 8d8} damage at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Blood of the Cosmos

entries: The cosmos is within us. We are made of star-stuff. We are a way for the universe to know itself.
The cosmos has blessed you with the ability to wield the light of the stars. Your place in this universe is marked with the love of the universe around you, and you have gained magic through that.

subclassFeature.name: Cosmos Spells
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Cosmos feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Blood of the Cosmos Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Radiant Soul
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Cosmos feature}
Your inner light adds to the damage of your luminous spells. When you cast a spell that deals radiant damage, the spell deals {@damage 1d4} additional radiant damage.

The extra damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to {@damage 1d6} at 5th level, {@damage 1d8} at 10th level, {@damage 1d10} at 14th level, and {@damage 2d6} at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Starry Blink
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Cosmos feature}

The stars smile down upon you. At 1st level, you can use your action to teleport to an open space within 30 feet of you that you can see. Upon your arrival, any creatures within 5 feet of you take {@damage 2d8} radiant damage, and are {@condition Blinded} until the beginning of your next turn. You can use this ability once per short rest. This ability scales to {@damage 3d8} radiant damage and 2 uses per short rest at 5th level, {@damage 4d8} and 3 uses at 11th level, and {@damage 5d8} and 4 uses at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Nebulous Being
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Cosmos feature}

The stars' light protects you. At 6th level, you gain resistance to radiant damage. Additionally, when a hostile creature attacks you, you can use your reaction to make your body incorporeal, adding +5 to your AC until the beginning of your next turn. You can use this ability twice per long rest. This scales to 3 times at 11th level, and 4 times at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Blessing of the Universe
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Cosmos feature}

Your inner light grows brighter. At 6th level, you can use a bonus action to touch an inanimate object or willing creature and cause them to emit a 30 foot radius of {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} for one hour.
Additionally, you can use a bonus action to float up to 1 foot off the ground. Your movement speeds are not affected by this.

subclassFeature.name: Stellar Flash
entries: {@i 14th-level Blood of the Cosmos feature}

You shine as bright as the stars above. At 14th level, you gain immunity to radiant damage. Additionally, the range of your {@subclassFeature Starry Blink|Sorcerer|PHB|Cosmos|GlensGrimoireOfMayhem|1} ability increases to 60 feet, and creatures within 10 feet of you now take damage upon your reappearance. At 18th level, this increases to 15 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Gravitational Field
entries: {@i 18th-level Blood of the Cosmos feature}

You have the same gravity as the stars themselves. At 18th level, you can use an action to choose a point within 100 feet of you that you can see. Every hostile creature within 60 feet must a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 10d6} force damage and are pulled 20 feet towards that point. On a success, they take half damage and remain stationary. You can use this ability twice per long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Blood of the Divine

entries: There is a touch of divinity even in brutes, and a special halo about a horse, that should forever exempt him from indignities.

entries.name: A note from the mage...
entries: This is a reworking of the original 5e {@subclass Divine Soul|Sorcerer|PHB|XGE} subclass from {@book Xanathar's Guide to Everything|XGE}. I am of the opinion that anyone with eyes and a basic knowledge of how D&D 5e works can see that that subclass is woefully lacking, and so I have taken it upon myself to overhaul the original concept.

At some point in your life, whether at birth, after a quest, or by complete accident, you were blessed by a deity or higher power, giving you an incomparable inner radiance. This has given you a unique connection to magic, possibly to the displeasure of religious organizations related to the entity who blessed you.
The nature of this deity determines the magic you wield: whether they are a being of good, evil, or otherwise, the powers they have given you depend on that nature.

subclassFeature.name: Divine Spells
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Divine feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Blood of the Divine Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

Additionally, when you select this origin, you pick a nature for your divine blessing: Good, Evil, Neutrality, Law, or Chaos. Based on your selection, you learn more additional spells with the same rules as above.

subclassFeature.name: Blessed Spark
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Divine feature}

The blessing that runs through your veins allows you to bless or bane yourself and others. At 1st level, you can use either your bonus action or reaction to add or subtract a {@dice d4||Blessed Spark} to an ability check or saving throw that you or a creature within 30 feet of you makes. You can use this ability twice per short rest. This scales to 3 times at 5th level, 4 times at 10th level, 5 times at 14th level, and 6 times at 18th level.
The die you add scales to {@dice 1d6||Blessed Spark} at 5th level, {@dice 1d8||Blessed Spark} at 10th level, {@dice 1d10||Blessed Spark} at 14th level, and {@dice 2d6||Blessed Spark} at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Divine Energy
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Divine feature}

The divinity within you allows your mere touch to bestow that blessing onto others, or to inflict pain upon them. Beginning at 1st level, you have a pool of divine energy that replenishes whenever you finish a long rest. This pool consists of energy points equal to your Sorcerer level × 5. You can use these energy points to heal others, or to harm them. If used to heal, you can touch a creature and restore a number of hit points to them, up to the maximum number you have in your pool. If used to harm, you can use your action to make a ranged or melee spell attack, and on a hit, deal an amount of radiant damage to a creature up to the maximum number of energy points in your pool.
The range of the ranged spell attack begins at 60 feet at 1st level, then increases to 90 feet at 6th level, and 120 feet at 12th level.

subclassFeature.name: Sacred Healing
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Divine feature}

You can use your pool of divine energy to cleanse or curse others. At 6th level, you can spend energy points to heal or inflict diseases. It costs 5 points per disease healed or inflicted. To cure diseases, you must be able to touch the person you are healing. To inflict diseases, you must make a melee or ranged spell attack against the creature you want to infect. On a hit, the creature is infected with the disease of your choice.
{@filter Diseases|conditionsdiseases|source=|type=disease|miscellaneous=} you can inflict should be preemptively discussed with your DM.
Additionally, once per long rest, you can use 10 of your energy points to do one of the following:

items: Remove a level of {@condition exhaustion} from a creature
Remove the {@condition charmed} or {@condition petrified} condition from a creature
Remove a curse from a creature, including one gained from {@quickref attunement|DMG|1} to a magic item
Remove any reduction to one of a creature's ability scores
Remove any reduction to a creature's maximum hit points

entries: You must be able to touch this creature to use this ability. This scales to two uses at 10th level, three uses at 14th level, and four uses at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Inner Light
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Divine feature}

Your inner radiance grows brighter. At 6th level, you gain resistance to radiant damage. Additionally, you can use your action to release a burst of divine light. Every hostile creature within 30 feet of you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are {@condition blinded} for one minute. On a success, they are {@condition blinded} until the beginning of your next turn. You can use this ability twice per long rest. This scales to three times at 10th level, four times at 14th level, and five times at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Holy Radiance
entries: {@i 14th-level Blood of the Divine feature}

The divinity within you manifests further. At 14th level, you gain immunity to radiant damage. Additionally, you gain a magical flying speed of 60 feet. While you are airborne, wings with an appearance akin to your divine nature (you choose what they look like) appear on your back, and disappear once you return to the ground.

subclassFeature.name: Spirit of the Divine
entries: {@i 18th-level Blood of the Divine feature}

Your connection with your divine magic has grown so strong that it bursts at the edges of your being. At 18th level, during combat, you can use your bonus action to enter a state fueled by your divine blessing. For one minute, you radiate an aura of divine light, and gain the following benefits:

items: Any creature that comes within 10 feet of you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 4d8||Spirit of the Divine} radiant damage and are {@condition blinded} until the beginning of your next turn. On a success, they take half damage and are not {@condition blinded}.

When you cast a spell that deals radiant damage, roll a {@chance 25|d4|Spirit of the Divine|The target of the spell is {@condition blinded} until the beginning of your next turn.}. If you roll a 1, the target of the spell is {@condition blinded} until the beginning of your next turn.
All ranged attacks made against you have disadvantage.

entries: You can use this feature twice per long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Blood of the Storm

entries: It is only in sorrow bad weather masters us; in joy we face the storm and defy it.

entries.name: A note from the mage...
entries: This is a reworking of the original 5e {@subclass Storm|Sorcerer|PHB|XGE|Storm Sorcery} subclass from {@book Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide|SCAG}. While some might prefer its approach to the sorcerer class, I personally find it to be overly focused on flavor-text rather than utility. As such, I have taken it upon myself to overhaul it, retaining a few details, and make it more usable for those who, like myself, prefer the DPS/glass cannon method of playing sorcerers.

Sorcerers of this bloodline have the power of wind and lightning in their veins. Whether your magic was passed down to you through your lineage, or you were somehow gifted or cursed with these abilities, you contain the power of the wildest storms within you.

subclassFeature.name: Storm Spells
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Storm feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Storm Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Wind Speaker
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Storm feature}

Your magic has gifted you arcane abilities infused with the weather itself. You can speak, read, and write {@language Primordial}. Knowing this language allows you to understand and be understood by those who speak its dialects: {@language Primordial||Aquan}, {@language Primordial||Auran}, {@language Primordial||Ignan}, and {@language Primordial||Terran}.

subclassFeature.name: Storm Currents
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Storm feature}

At 1st level, you gain the ability to summon the winds around you for protection. Once per long rest, when an enemy creature targets you with an attack, you can use your reaction to roll a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, you evade the attack and take no damage. This ability scales to two uses at 5th level, three uses at 11th level, and four uses at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Static Field
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Storm feature}
Your skin crackles with the energy of the storms you harness. Starting at 6th level, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage.

In addition, when you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal lightning or thunder damage to the attacker. The damage equals your sorcerer level plus your Charisma modifier. The attacker must also make a Strength saving throw against your sorcerer spell save DC. On a failed save, the attacker is pushed in a straight line up to 20 feet away from you.

subclassFeature.name: Hurricane's Eye
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Storm feature}

At 6th level, you have gained the ability to harness the pure electricity crackling within your veins. Once per long rest, you can choose one spell of 5th level or lower that deals lightning or thunder damage and deal the maximum damage with that spell on the turn that you cast it. This scales to twice per long rest at 12th level, and three times per long rest at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Wind Soul
entries: {@i 14th-level Blood of the Storm feature}
Your abilities have grown into a maelstrom within you. At 14th level, you gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage.

In addition, you gain 60 feet of magical flying speed. As a bonus action, you can reduce your flying speed by 30 feet for 10 minutes and choose one friendly creature within 30 feet of you. This creature gains a magical flying speed of 30 feet for 10 minutes. You can use this ability three times per long rest. This scales to four times per long rest at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Heart of the Storm
entries: {@i 18th-level Blood of the Storm feature}

At 18th level, you have become fully attuned with the storms you control. You now have more mastery over your powers than ever before. Once per turn, as a free action, you may reduce the cost of a Metamagic option by 1 Sorcery Point (to a minimum of 1 Sorcery Point) on a spell of any level that does lightning or thunder damage. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Blood of the Wild

entries: It's a cruel and random world, but the chaos is all so beautiful.

entries.name: A note from the mage...
entries: This is a reworking of the original 5e {@subclass Wild|Sorcerer|PHB|PHB|Wild Magic Sorcery} subclass from the 2014 {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. While some might prefer its approach to the concept, I personally find it to have an uninspired approach to the concept. In my opinion, the development of the subclass does not allow for as much character growth as it should, as it presents the wild magic sorcerer as a vessel with none to minimal control, rather than someone who can learn to work with the magic instead of against it.

Wild magic has somehow touched you. Whether you obtained this through random chance, contact with the elemental plane, or by accident, chaos follows you wherever you go. Whether you harness it or not is completely up to you.

subclassFeature.name: Spells of the Wild
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Wild feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Spells of the Wild table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

entries: {@spell Cacophonic Shield|FRHoF} is a 5.5e spell. If you don't want to use any 5.5e content, you can replace it with my spell {@spell Curse of Emotional Damage|GlensGrimoireOfMayhem}.

subclassFeature.name: Wild Magic Surge
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Wild feature}

Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your magic can escape the confines of your being both in battle and in normal life. In battle, whenever you cast a spell, whether that be a leveled spell or cantrip, roll a d20. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge combat table to create a magical effect. If you roll higher than a 1, increase the threshold for a Wild Magic Surge by 1. Continue this process until you roll a Wild Magic Surge, then reset the threshold.
Additionally, whenever you cast a spell outside of battle, make a roll on the passive effects column of the wild magic table.
{@homebrew |You can find my homebrew wild magic table in an appendix at the end of this document. Click here to navigate to it.}

subclassFeature.name: Tides of Chaos
entries: {@i 1st-level Blood of the Wild feature}

You can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos. Starting at 1st level, you can, after you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, roll another {@dice D20||Tides of Chaos} and take the higher roll. You can use this ability two times per long rest. This scales to three uses at 5th level, four uses at 9th level, five uses at 13th level, and six uses at 17th level.
Whenever you use this feature, the threshold on your {@subclassFeature Wild Magic Surge|Sorcerer|PHB|Wild|GlensGrimoireOfMayhem|1} goes up by 1.

subclassFeature.name: Wild Vessel
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Wild feature}

You can bend the wild magic you contain to your advantage, using it to power your spells. At 6th level, once per long rest, you can use your action to cast one spell of 2nd level or lower without expending a spell slot. This increases to 3rd level or lower at 10th level, 4th level or lower at 14th level, and 5th level or lower at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Mayhem Mastery
entries: {@i 6th-level Blood of the Wild feature}

You can bend the magic churning within you to your will. At 6th level, during combat, you can use a bonus action to make a roll on your {@subclassFeature Wild Magic Surge|Sorcerer|PHB|Wild|GlensGrimoireOfMayhem|1} combat table, and apply the effects to one creature you can see. This scales to twice per short rest at 12th level and three times per short rest at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Spell Bombardment
entries: {@i 14th-level Blood of the Wild feature}

Beginning at 14th level, the harmful energy of your spells intensifies. When you roll damage for a spell and roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, you may roll them again and add results of those rolls to the damage. You can use this feature only once per turn.

subclassFeature.name: Erratic Amplification
entries: {@i 18th-level Blood of the Wild feature}

Beginning at 18th level, you can upcast a spell of 5th level or lower without expending a spell slot of that higher level. Instead, the spell consumes a spell slot of its original level. You can use this feature once per long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Mirage Sorcery

entries: Now you see me...
now you don't.

Your blood runs with the power to cast powerful illusions. Perhaps you are descended from a trickster god, or you were given a gift from one of the fey. This has granted you the ability to change others' perceptions of the world, for better, or for worse.

subclassFeature.name: Mirage Spells
entries: {@i 1st-level Mirage Sorcery feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Mirage Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Weaponized Illusions
entries: {@i 1st-level Mirage Sorcery feature}
You know how the twist your illusions to harm others. When you cast a spell that deals psychic damage, the spell deals {@damage 1d4} additional psychic damage.

The extra damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to {@damage 1d6} at 5th level, {@damage 1d8} at 10th level, {@damage 1d10} at 14th level, and {@damage 2d6} at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Illusory Haze
entries: {@i 1st-level Mirage Sorcery feature}

The lines of your form are blurry and indistinct, making you a difficult target. Beginning at 1st level, you can use your reaction to give a hostile creature targeting you disadvantage on their attack roll. If the creature fails their attack roll due to this ability, they are caught off guard, granting advantage on the next attack against them, or disadvantage on their next saving throw, whichever comes first. You can use this ability twice per long rest. This scales to three uses at 6th level, four uses at 12th level, and five uses at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: It May Not Be What It Seems
entries: {@i 6th-level Mirage Sorcery feature}

Your illusions are difficult to distinguish from reality. At 6th level, creatures have disadvantage on ability checks made to recognize the true nature of your illusions, or to remember your face or voice.

subclassFeature.name: Veil Piercer
entries: {@i 6th-level Mirage Sorcery feature}

Your experience handling illusions gives you insight into noticing and dispelling the illusions of others. Beginning at 6th level, you have advantage on ability checks to locate and identify the nature of illusions.

Additionally, you can use an action to attempt to dispel another spellcaster's spell of the illusion school of magic. Make a Charisma check with a DC of 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends. At 14th level, you gain advantage on this check.

subclassFeature.name: After-Image
entries: {@i 14th-level Blood of the Wild feature}

You can move around the world, leaving an image of yourself in your wake. At 14th level, you can use a bonus action to teleport up to 60 feet away into an unoccupied space. When you use this ability, you leave an illusion of yourself in your place. While this illusion exists, you are {@condition invisible}. The {@condition invisible||invisibility} ends if you target a hostile creature with a spell, unarmed, or weapon attack, or if your illusory self is targeted with a spell, unarmed, or weapon attack.

While your illusory self exists, you can a bonus action to cause it to move up to 30 feet from its current location. Another creature can discover the nature of the illusion by succeeding an {@skill Investigation} or {@skill Perception} check with a DC equal to your spell save.
You can use this ability once per short rest. This increases to twice per short rest at 18th level.

subclassFeature.name: Indistinct Self
entries: {@i 18th-level Mirage Sorcery feature}

Your mastery over illusions has grown to the point that the magic has fused with your physical body. Starting at 18th level, you can use your bonus action to enter a state fueled by your illusion magic. For one minute, you gain the following benefits:

items: All ranged attacks made against you have disadvantage.
You have resistance to non-magical slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning damage.
You do not provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

entries: You can use this feature twice per long rest.

spell.name: Ailbhe's Magical Mayhem
entries: You summon the magic of pure chaos and bend it to your will. Make a roll on a {@filter Wild Magic table|tables|source=|miscellaneous=|search=wild magic} and apply it to one creature within range, which can be yourself. The effect is exactly as specified on the table with no alterations.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can choose one additional effect to apply for each slot level above 2nd. You can apply all of these effects to the same creature or different ones, but you cannot choose the same effect on the table more than once.

spell.name: Augustine's Paralyzing Smite
entries: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, the attack deals an extra {@damage 5d8} radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of your next turn.

spell.name: Chromatic Expansion
entries: You summon the power of raw chaos to use as a weapon of destruction. Choose a point within range. An unstable sphere of pure chaos expands from it. You choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder for the sphere you create. Each creature within the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 5d8} damage of the type you choose. On a successful save, the creature only takes half damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|4-9|1d8} for each slot level above 4th. Additionally, if cast at 6th level or higher, the sphere increases in size to 25 feet, and if cast at 8th level or higher, the sphere increases in size to 30 feet.

spell.name: Cowboyification
entries: You invoke in another creature the urge to seek out a simpler life. Choose a creature within range to target. That creature makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they are filled with a longing for the prairie life: herding cattle, sitting mournfully on top of a horse on the edge of a cliff while looking out at the sunset, managing a ranch, etc. This effect is not debilitating, but it is distracting. While it lasts, the affected creature will actively seek out things that remind them of the life that they long for, such as attire befitting a cowboy, horses, and cattle.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd or 3rd level, the effect lasts for 8 hours. When you use a spell slot of 4th or 5th level, it lasts for 24 hours. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, it lasts for a week. If cast at 9th level, the spell becomes indefinite, the creature has disadvantage on the Charisma saving throw, and the creature will eventually, once they have obtained the means to do so, run away to become a cowboy.

spell.name: Crystalline Spikes

components.m: a large crystal or gem, sharpened to a point

entries: A 40-foot square of sharp crystal stalagmites sprouts from the ground centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature in the square must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes {@damage 10d4} piercing damage, or half as much failure on a success. The crystals remain in the area for one minute, turning the area into difficult terrain. Any creature falling from at least five feet onto the crystals takes the spell's damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d4|5-9|3d4} for every slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Curse of Consuming Flame
entries: You call upon the magic of the elementals to consume your enemies. Choose a creature to target. That creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} fire damage. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} fire damage, and is cursed.
At the beginning of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw. On a failed save, it takes an additional {@damage 2d8} fire damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the initial fire damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|2d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Curse of Creeping Cold
entries: You call upon the magic of the elementals to curse your enemies. Choose a creature to target. That creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} cold damage. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} cold damage, and is cursed.
At the beginning of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw. On a failed save, it takes an additional {@damage 2d8} cold damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the initial cold damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|2d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Curse of Emotional Damage
entries: You curse your enemies with the memories of their most embarrassing moments. Choose a creature to target. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} psychic damage. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} psychic damage, and is cursed.
At the beginning of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw. On a failed save, it takes an additional {@damage 2d8} psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the initial psychic damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|2d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Curse of Lingering Rot
entries: You summon the power of the rot to curse your enemies. Choose a creature to target. That creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage, and is cursed.
At the beginning of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw. On a failed save, it takes an additional {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the initial necrotic damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|2d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Cypress's Starlight Laser
entries: You concentrate the power of the stars into one single ray of light. Choose a creature to target. That creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a fail, the creature takes {@damage 10d8} radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} until the beginning of your next turn. On a success, the creature takes half damage and is {@condition blinded} until the beginning of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the radiant damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d8|6-9|2d8} for each slot level above 6th.

spell.name: Decompose
entries: You summon the power of nature to prematurely bring rot to your enemies. Choose two creatures to target. A mass of bacteria bloom and begin eating away at the creature. A creature targeted by this spell must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage. On a success, a creature takes half damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|1d8} for each slot level above 3rd, and you can target one additional creature for each two slot levels above 3rd.

spell.name: Fire Bomb
entries: You call upon wind and flame to bombard your enemies. Choose one creature as a target. Make two ranged spell attacks, one after the other. If the first hits, but not the second, the target takes {@damage 3d8} fire damage. If the second hits, but not the first, the target takes {@damage 3d8} slashing damage. If both hit, the target takes {@damage 6d8} fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the fire and slashing damage for the individual attacks increase by {@scaledamage 3d8|4-9|1d8}, and the fire damage for the overall attack increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|4-9|2d8} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Flea Swarm
entries: A swarm of fleas answers your call and descends upon your enemies. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d6} poison damage. For the duration, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns. On a failure, it takes an additional {@damage 2d4} poison damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} and the later damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|1-9|1d4} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Freeze-Dry
entries: You slowly freeze the moisture throughout the body of your target. Choose one creature within range to target. That creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes {@damage 2d6} cold damage as it begins to freeze from the inside out. On a success, nothing happens. At the beginning of each of your turns for as long as you maintain {@condition concentration}, the target makes another Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} cold damage upon a failure and nothing happening upon a success. Once the creature fails 5 saving throws, it has disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws, disadvantage on attack rolls, and its movement speeds halved until the spell ends, or until your {@condition concentration} is broken, whichever comes first.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the creature takes an additional {@scaledamage 2d6|4-9|1d6} cold damage per Constitution saving throw failed for every slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Guardian's Instinct
entries: You can magically sense the general location of a creature of your choice. Choose one creature in range to target. For the next hour, you are able to sense the general direction and distance of the creature from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for every slot level above 1st. Additionally, when cast at 2nd level, the spell lasts for 6 hours, when cast at 3rd level, the spell lasts for 12 hours, and when cast at 4th level or higher, the spell lasts for 24 hours.

spell.name: Gun
entries: A high speed projectile shoots out of a point on your body that you choose to pierce your enemies. Choose one creature that you can see within range, and make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of second level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|1-9|1d8}, and you can target one additional creature for every two slot levels above 1st.

spell.name: Ice Glaze
entries: The terrain around you freezes over, creating an icy disaster zone for those who dare to step foot on it. A sheet of ice radiates out from you, creating difficult terrain and coating everything except living creatures. Water {@condition frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by this spell becomes a sheet of ice thick enough to safely walk on. Any creature who is standing on the ground or a nonliving object touching the ground in the radius of this spell when it is cast must succeed a Dexterity saving throw or have their movement speed reduced to 0 as their feet are {@condition frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} to the ground. Those who have their speed reduced like this can make a Strength saving throw at the beginning of their turns to escape the ice on a success.

Any creature who attempts to move on the terrain you have created must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, they can move freely. On a failure, their movement speed is reduced by half for the rest of their turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell at 6th level or higher, the radius of the spell's effect increases by 10 feet for every slot level above 5th. Additionally, when you cast this spell at 7th level or higher, you no longer need to {@condition concentration||concentrate} on this spell.

spell.name: Imari's Song of Encouragement

time.condition: which you take when a creature within range misses with an attack roll, or fails a saving throw or ability check

entries: You expend a use of your {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|PHB|1}, roll the die, and add the result to the target creature's dice roll.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can expend and roll one additional {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|PHB|1} die for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Infuse Crystal

components.m: a quartz crystal of at least one cubic inch in size

entries: You infuse a crystal with a spell of your choosing. Choose a 1st-level spell, and make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, that spell is now stored in the crystal, and the crystal turns the color of the school of magic the spell belongs to. On a failure, nothing happens, and the spell fails.

Once the spell is stored inside the crystal, you lose one of your spell slots of the spell's level. This spell slot is not regained upon long or short rests, and remains unusable until the spell is released from the crystal. Once the spell is released from the crystal, you regain the use of the spell slot after your next long rest.

To release the spell from the crystal, you use your action to make an ability check (or saving throw, your choice) using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell is cast as if you were in the crystal's space, is no longer stored in the crystal, and you regain the spell slot when you finish a long rest. On a failure, the spell is not cast, and you roll a {@dice d20}. If you roll a 1, the spell leaves the crystal with no effect, and you regain use of the spell slot after your next long rest.
You do not have to be touching the crystal to release the spell inside it, but you must be on the same plane of existence, and within 120 feet of it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can store a spell of one level higher than 1st level for every slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Linnea's Circle of Lunar Protection

components.m: a vial of saltwater collected during the full moon

entries: You summon the power of the moon to guard you. A magical dome appears, centered on you, which defends you and anyone else within the dome from outside harm. Any hostile creature who attempts to enter the dome must make a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 6d8} radiant damage and be {@condition blinded}. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage, is only {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn, and is able to pass through the barrier.
The barrier has 50 hit points; is immune to poison, psychic, and radiant damage; is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and is vulnerable to force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the radiant damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|7-9|2d8} for each slot level above 7th, and the dome has an additional 25 hit points for each slot level above 7th.

spell.name: Lucius's Guiding Light
entries: You summon a mote of light to guide you to an object of your choosing within 300 feet of you. The object must fit into a 1-foot cube, and this spell does not work on objects that you are not familiar with, or could not easily identify.

races.name: Half-Elf (Variant; Moon Elf or Sun Elf Descent)

spell.name: Messenger Spirit
entries: You conjure a small spirit to carry a message for you. This spirit appears as a Beast-type creature of your choosing. If the creature is larger than Tiny size, then it appears as that size instead. The creature can carry either the message written on a piece of paper, or deliver a sound recording of no longer than 10 seconds. The spirit delivers this message to a creature that you are familiar with, and that you can name. Once the spirit successfully delivers the message to the creature, it dissipates.

races.name: Half-Elf (Variant; Moon Elf or Sun Elf Descent)

spell.name: Meteor Beam

components.m: a small piece of a meteorite

entries: You summon forth the power of space to obliterate your foes. You gather cosmic power around yourself, and fire a beam of pure spatial matter 100 feet long and 5 feet wide which blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 4d6} bludgeoning damage and {@damage 4d6} radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bludgeoning or the radiant damage (your choice) increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|4-9|1d6} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Meteor Shower
entries: Starstuff falls from the sky, assailing your foes. Choose up to six creatures within range and make a ranged spell attack against each creature. On a hit, a target takes {@damage 3d8} bludgeoning damage and {@damage 3d8} radiant damage, and it and all creatures within 10 feet of it are {@condition blinded} until the beginning of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Nico's Tempestuous Wrath
entries: You summon a cumulonimbus cloud to strike your enemies down. A 30-foot radius sphere centered on you is engulfed by the storm cloud for the duration.

When you cast the spell, you can call down up to two bolts of lightning. You can direct the bolts at one target or multiple. A creature makes a Dexterity saving throw for each bolt targeting it. A creature hit by a bolt takes {@damage 3d12} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If the target critically fails its saving throw, it is {@condition paralyzed} until the start of your next turn.

After you call down lightning, creatures of your choice within the cloud must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d8} thunder damage and is {@condition deafened} until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not {@condition deafened}.

On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to call down lightning in this way again, targeting the same creatures or different ones. If you move while you are {@condition concentration||concentrating} on this spell, your {@condition concentration} is broken, and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you can call down one additional lightning bolt with each action for each slot level above 7th.

spell.name: Robin's Elemental Versatility
entries: You summon the power of the elements to aid your combat. Choose up to two weapons, or your unarmed strikes (If you choose a ranged weapon, all projectiles you fire from it while the spell is active receive this effect). When you deal damage with one of these weapons, you can choose for the weapon to deal acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage in place of its normal damage type. This change lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

spell.name: Shatter Strike
entries: You coat up to two weapons you are holding with a thin sheen of crystals. If you choose a weapon with the ammunition property, all ammunition fired from the weapon gains the effects of the spell. When you make an attack using an affected weapon, the attack deals an additional {@damage 1d4} piercing damage as some of the crystal shatters and splinters dig into the target. The remaining crystal vanishes harmlessly at the beginning of your next turn.

races.name: Half-Elf (Variant; Moon Elf or Sun Elf Descent)

spell.name: Static Skin
entries: Lightning forms a protective barrier around you. Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 1d12} lightning damage. On a success, they take half damage. If the attack was made with a metal weapon, a metal spell, or by a creature made of metal, the damage increases to {@damage 2d12}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d12|2-9|1d12} for each slot level above 2nd. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can maintain your {@status concentration} on the spell for up to 10 minutes.

spell.name: Stellar Aura
entries: The light of the stars blazes from you. For the duration, you shed {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} in a 5-foot radius and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} for an additional 5 feet. Creatures of your choice that start their turn in the {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} or enter it for the first time on a turn must make a Constitution saving throw. On a fail, they take {@damage 2d8} radiant damage. On a success, the creature only takes half damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radiant damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each slot level above 2nd, and the radius of the aura increases by 5 feet for each two slot levels above 2nd.

spell.name: Water Lock
entries: You summon a sphere of water to trap your foes. Choose a creature to target. That creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature is encased in a sphere of water large enough to hold them comfortably with space to spare. While in this sphere, their movement speed is reduced to 0, they have {@quickref cover||3||total cover} from all other creatures, and all other creatures have {@quickref cover||3||total cover} from them. On a success, the spell fails.

At the beginning of every turn that the creature is encased in the sphere of water, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they breathe in a small amount of water, and take {@damage 3d6} necrotic damage. On a success, they take half damage. If they fail 4 Constitution saving throws, then they must begin making Death saving throws, as they have breathed in too much water and are now actively drowning.

Another creature can help free the creature within the sphere of water by standing adjacent to the trapped creature and using its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing the creature on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the creature takes an additional {@scaledamage 3d6|6-9|1d6} necrotic damage per Constitution saving throw for every slot level above 6th. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you can maintain {@condition concentration} on the spell for up to 10 minutes.

spell.name: Chromatic Vortex

m.text: a diamond worth at least 500 GP

entries: You tap into and, for a split second, release the power of pure chaos into the world. A churning vortex of wild magic appears in an unoccupied space that you choose on the map. All hostile creatures within a 60 foot radius of the vortex must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, roll a {@dice d8} on the table provided below and apply the effects to the creature. On a success, roll a {@dice d8} on the table below, and the creature takes the damage, but suffers none of the other effects.

rows: The target is splattered with acids that eat through their garments and into their flesh. If they are wearing armor, the target takes {@damage 10d6} acid damage and the armor is rendered useless, losing its ability to protect its wearer. If they are not wearing armor, then they take {@damage 15d6} acid damage and are {@condition incapacitated} until the beginning of your next turn.

The target is chilled to the bone as cold purveys their soul and a layer of ice covers their skin. They take {@damage 12d8} cold damage and are {@condition restrained} until they succeed a Strength saving throw, which they make at the beginning of each of their turns.

The target is assailed with a torrent of flame. They take {@damage 12d6} fire damage, and take an additional {@damage 4d6} fire damage at the beginning of each of their turns until they succeed a Dexterity saving throw to extinguish the fire on their person, which they make at the beginning of each of their turns.
The target is hit with a bolt of lightning so powerful that it fries their senses. They take 12d6 {@damage 12d6} lightning damage and are {@condition paralyzed} for one minute.

The target is enveloped by death energy, disturbing their mind and body. They take {@damage 12d8} necrotic damage and are {@condition frightened} of you until they succeed a Wisdom saving throw, which is made at the beginning of each of their turns.

The target is inflicted with poisons beyond the mortal imagination. They take {@damage 12d6} poison damage, are {@condition poisoned}, and take {@damage 5d6} additional poison damage at the beginning of each of their turns. Both of the latter effects last until they succeed a Constitution saving throw, which is made directly after taking the additional poison damage.

A flash of blinding light burns away at the target's being. They take {@damage 12d8} radiant damage and are {@condition blinded} until they succeed a Constitution saving throw, which they make at the beginning of their turns.

The target hears a noise so loud that it permeates their soul and disrupts their physical form. They take {@damage 15d6} thunder damage, are {@condition stunned} until the beginning of their next turn, and are {@condition deafened} until they succeed a Constitution saving throw, which they make at the beginning of each of their turns.

item.name: Fey-Blessed Crown
entries: This delicate, leaf-adorned crown is woven with the blessings of the fey craftsman who created it. It was gifted by Princess Imari of Breland to her wife, Robin ir'Morgrave, as a symbol of their shared love and commitment. It has a total of six charges, and regains all charges when you complete a long rest. You can expend charges through to cause these effects:

entries.name: Protection of the Fey
entries: When targeted with an attack, as a reaction, you can expend 2 charges, and temporarily increase your AC by +4. This bonus lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.name: Fey's Wrath
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action, you can use your bonus action to expend up to 3 charges (equal to the amount of weapon attacks included in your {@action Attack} action), and increase the number of damage dice you roll by the number of charges spent.
